Velykyy Zhvanchyk Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Khmelnytskyi Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. A 1995 IAJGS expedition documented a mid-19th-century gravestone here as the cemetery's oldest, but by the time the ESJF surveyed the site in 2019, that stone could no longer be found — one of several gradual losses recorded across this collection between successive surveys. The community, first mentioned in the 18th century and led from 1895 by Rabbi Abram-Pinkhas Berman, was largely destroyed on September 1, 1941, when 1,224 Jews from Velykyy Zhvanchyk and neighboring villages were executed together in the Sokoletz forest.
